[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40700815/0f2c32117d4b7ba95874a14be50cce4a8ea93dae.jpg[/img]

We hope you've been enjoying our biggest sale yet, and there's still less than 48 hours left to grab one of our titles for yourself or a friend! ːkarrynːːmeltysː

If you haven't been checking back at our previous news post for the changelogs, we have been steadily updating and renewing all the core combat CGs to the new art with new variations and facial expressions! With the core combat CGs and map CG completed during 2023, this year will be the remainder of the CGs to get them ready to support Karryn's new P Cups in the upcoming P Cup DLC! The current plan is to hopefully get the P Cup DLC out by the end of the first half of 2024!! ːkarrynGlassesː

Furthermore, with 2024 and Steam's official stopping of supporting Windows 7 and 8 at the start of 2024, we have now also updated to the latest version of nwjs (the backend rendering engine for the game which also dropped support for Windows 7) which should boost performance speed for most PCs. However, if it happens that you are having issues with the new version of nwjs, we have also provided a download link to the previous version of nwjs that we have been using down below:

[strike]https://mega.nz/file/ZfwjAYSY#sZ4YrSUCI1i9AQCBegzOUWfGZntK3UzYz2zCcOcHbz8

You will have to replace the files in your game folder with the files from the above link and then delete the 'vk_swiftshader.dll' , 'vk_swiftshader_icd.json' and 'vulkan-1.dll' files from your game folder's /www/ folder.[/strike]

As of v1.2.9.4, the nwjs engine has been reverted back to the old engine due to reports of people with major issues running the game. If you're still having issues, please backup your save folder and do a clean reinstall, which includes uninstalling the game and deleting any remaining files in the game folder before reinstalling.

As always, stay up to date by following us on our Discord and Twitter accounts!ːkarrynGlassesː
